# GlowLoox Partner

> GlowLoox Partner is the free business dashboard for salon, barbershop, spa, makeup and skin-clinic owners in India. Owners manage bookings, services, prices, staff, customers, reviews and their live walk-in queue — from the web and an Android app. Free to use.

## What GlowLoox Partner does
- Accept and manage appointment bookings in real time
- List services with custom prices and durations
- Manage a live walk-in queue
- Add staff and assign bookings to team members
- Track customers, visit history and reviews
- See daily, weekly and monthly business analytics
- Showcase work with a photo & video gallery
- Run coupons and offers

## Key facts
- Name: GlowLoox Partner (part of GlowLoox)
- Who it's for: salon, barbershop, spa & wellness, makeup & bridal, and skin & derma business owners
- Country served: India
- Pricing: Free to use
- Owner dashboard: https://owner.glowloox.com
- Android app: GlowLoox Partner (Google Play)
- Customer side: https://glowloox.com
- Contact: glowloox@gmail.com
